p: StegoShard is a local-only tool with no application backend.

p.b: It does not collect, transmit, sell, or profile personal data.

ul.b: Files, passwords, keys, filenames, and recovery shares are processed locally. Passwords are not intentionally persisted or transmitted.

The extension stores a password-wrapped key and preferences in storage.local, including an optional title that may contain personal data. While unlocked, the raw key is represented in volatile storage.session. The web app stores only non-secret UI preferences in localStorage.

ul: , and its core features make no network requests.

p: The hosted app downloads executable JavaScript. Processing stays local, but a compromised deployment could change that code. For high-value use, prefer a reviewed extension, CLI binary, or checksum/provenance-verified offline bundle.

ul: — save the wrapped key and preferences locally.
Public extension builds request no identity or host permissions.

p: You can export, re-password, lock, or erase the extension key. Uninstalling removes extension storage under normal browser behavior; web preferences remain until site data is cleared. Downloaded files are never removed automatically.
